description: With \(I=(p\lor q)\to r\), \(H=I\land\neg s\), \(\Gamma=\{p,H\}\), and \(\Delta=\Gamma,I,\neg s\), the specified cut-free input of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow r\lor t\) applies conjunction-left to \(H\), then implication-left to \(I\), with antecedent tree obtained by left-introducing \(p\lor q\) from atomic \(p\), and continuation obtained by left-introducing \(r\lor t\) from atomic \(r\).
